elderFuthark.note: 24 runes of the Elder Futhark (ca. 2nd-8th c. CE), arranged in three attir (families of eight). Reconstructed Proto-Germanic names and phonetics follow standard scholarship (Page 2005; Barnes 2012). Meanings are the conventional reconstructed glosses; runic divination associations are a later (medieval/modern) interpretive layer and are flagged as such.

runes.name: Fehu
runes.divination: Abundance, earned reward, momentum — but guard against hoarding.

runes.name: Uruz
runes.divination: Raw vitality, primal strength, a force worth taming.

runes.name: Thurisaz
runes.divination: A thorn: danger and catalyst at once. Act with care.

runes.name: Ansuz
runes.divination: Message, inspiration, the spoken word, Odin's breath.

runes.name: Raidho
runes.divination: Right movement, rhythm, a journey outward or inward.

runes.name: Kaunan
runes.divination: Illumination, knowledge that can also burn.

runes.name: Gebo
runes.divination: Partnership, a gift given and a gift returned. No inverse rune.

runes.name: Wunjo
runes.divination: Fulfilment, fellowship, the fruit of the first att.

runes.name: Hagalaz
runes.divination: Disruptive change, a hailstorm that clears the field.

runes.name: Nauthiz
runes.divination: Necessity, friction that forges. Endure to transform.

runes.name: Isa
runes.divination: Stillness, blockage, a clean pause. Wait for the thaw.

runes.name: Jera
runes.divination: Right timing, reward after the cycle completes.

runes.name: Eihwaz
runes.divination: Endurance, the world-axis, life-death-life.

runes.name: Perthro
runes.divination: Mystery, fate's dice-cup, what is hidden.

runes.name: Algiz
runes.divination: A shield-ward, defence, the upward reach.

runes.name: Sowilo
runes.divination: Success, the sun that cannot be lost, clarity.

runes.name: Tiwaz
runes.divination: Justice, sacrifice, the spear of purpose.

runes.name: Berkana
runes.divination: Growth, birth, the greening branch.

runes.name: Ehwaz
runes.divination: Movement in partnership, trust, the steed.

runes.name: Mannaz
runes.divination: The self in the collective, the mirror of others.

runes.name: Laguz
runes.divination: Intuition, the tide, what moves beneath.

runes.name: Ingwaz
runes.divination: Inner rest, gestation, the seed before sprouting.

runes.name: Dagaz
runes.divination: Breakthrough, dawn, the turning point. No inverse rune.

runes.name: Othala
runes.divination: Roots, inheritance, what was handed down.
